Proposition
[exponential decay of the trace-free Hessian] Source: cao-zhu 1. Proposition 5.1.9\group Normalized Ricci Flow on Surfaces

Let $(M,g_{ij}(t))$ be a solution of the normalized Ricci flow on a compact surface with $\chi (M)>0$. Then there exist positive constants $c$ and $C$ depending only on the initial metric such that \[ |M_{ij}|^2\leq Ce^{-ct},\quad \text{ on }\; M\times [0,+\infty ). \]
